instruction: Change the title font size to 24 points and make it bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Multi-step task requiring both font size change (44pt to 24pt = 304800 EMU) and bold formatting. Originally title is 44pt (558800 EMU) and not bold. Scoring: 0.5 for correct size (within tolerance), 0.5 for bold=True. This allows partial credit if agent completes only one step.

scoring_breakdown.1.0: Font size changed to 24pt AND text is bold

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Both requirements (font size to 24pt and bold) are verified by the evaluator
Correct getter logic: Extracts both font_size (EMU) and bold properties from the title text run containing 'Neural Network'
Correct metric logic: Properly compares font_size with tolerance (304800 ± 100 EMU) and bold as boolean
Accurate expected values: 24pt = 304800 EMU (24 × 12700), bold = true
Appropriate partial credit: 0.5 for font size + 0.5 for bold allows proper scoring of multi-step task
Proper postconfig: Saves file (Ctrl+S) to persist changes before verification
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts state → Metric compares → Partial scoring logic works
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Title identification relies on text containing 'Neural Network' with len < 20, which could be fragile if title text changes. Consider using shape.has_text_frame and shape.is_placeholder to identify title more robustly
Minor: Getter only checks first run (para.runs[0]). If title has mixed formatting, this might miss partial bold state. For typical use cases this is acceptable
